title: Federal Reserve Board - Federal Reserve Board invites comment on three proposed rules intended to help ensure banks maintain strong capital positions
主要内容: The Federal Reserve Board invited comment on three proposed rules to ensure banks maintain strong capital positions, enabling continued lending to creditworthy households and businesses during economic downturns. The rules aim to address regulatory capital requirements shortcomings identified during the recent financial crisis. The proposals include a new minimum common equity tier 1 ratio of 4.5 percent of risk-weighted assets, a common equity tier 1 capital conservation buffer of 2.5 percent of risk-weighted assets, and an increase in the minimum tier 1 capital ratio from 4 percent to 6 percent of risk-weighted assets. The rules also revise the definition of capital to improve the ability of regulatory capital instruments to absorb losses and establish limitations on capital distributions and discretionary bonus payments if specified buffers are not met. Advanced approaches banking organizations are defined as those with consolidated total assets of at least $250 billion or consolidated total on-balance sheet foreign exposures of at least $10 billion. Market risk banking organizations are those with aggregate trading assets and trading liabilities equal to at least 10 percent of quarter-end total assets or $1 billion.
